title: Major League Soccers Columbus Crew Relying on Vertiv Power and IT Management Systems to Support World-Class Fan Experience
summary: The new home of the 2020 MLS Cup champion Columbus Crew, Lower.com Field, boasts one of the most digitally advanced fan experiences in modern sport, starting with a best-in-class entry system that allows fast, easy access for up to 20,000 fans every game. That system, along with others in the Crew’s digital toolbox, ensures a seamless fan experience and serves as a blueprint for additional stadiums and arenas around the world. Vertiv (NYSE: VRT), a global provider of critical digital infrastructure and continuity solutions, makes sure it all runs smoothly as a proud supporter and neighbor of the Crew.
